name: print-social-candle-shop-feed-on-phone-over-woven-armchair
title: Pastel candle-shop profile on a phone resting on a taupe woven armchair arm
whatItIs: A phone showing a candle brand's profile grid of pink, green, blue and cream posts lies on the arm of a textured taupe armchair with soft shadows, framed by a thin brown rounded border.
whatItMeans: Soft and cosy; the neutral chair makes the pastel feed glow.
techniques: Place the phone on a large neutral textile.
Let the pastel grid be the only colour.

vocabulary.definition: A plain fabric as a mockup surface.
